# nodns-registrar

> BETA — Experimental. Use test sats only (testnut.cashu.space). Do not use real Cashu tokens.

## What this is

A user-friendly DNS registrar for NoDNS — decentralized DNS records from Nostr events.
Search for a name, pay with Cashu test sats, your record is live globally in seconds.

## Key URLs

- Bot API: https://nodns.shop
- Source: https://github.com/Amperstrand/nodns-poc (nodns-registrar/ directory)
- Docs: https://github.com/Amperstrand/nodns-poc/tree/main/docs

## Protocol

Publishes Nostr kind 11111 events with DNS record tags + Cashu payment tags.
The bot (Rust) subscribes to relays, validates signatures, verifies Cashu tokens, pushes TSIG-signed DDNS updates to Knot DNS.

## Supported zones

- nodns.shop (beta)
- .cv (pilot — simulate mode, not yet live)

## Cashu

Test sats only from https://testnut.cashu.space
NUT-18 payment requests supported for wallet-to-wallet scanning.

## Relays

- wss://relay.cashu.email
- wss://relay.tollgate.me

## Identity

- NIP-07 browser extension (preferred)
- Paste nsec (with security warning)
- Ephemeral key (privacy default)
